notes.title: Fugue of Delights – Coming July 23rd
notes.content:
Mark the date. Fugue of Delights, the fifth chronicle in the Enygmage universe, will be released on July 23rd. A deeper descent into the textures of desire, delirium, and dream.


Elylah returns — wounded, radiant, and relentless. Vulpes burns. The daemonic dream fractures. And you are not ready.

This new installment brings:

Refined artwork in chiaroscuro dreamscapes.

Tense erotic encounters and layered choices.

A descent into the heart of art, lust, and memory.

The fugue is a spiral. You won’t know what you’ve lost until it ends.


Add to your wishlist now and be the first to descend.  The stage is set. The curtain trembles.

notes.title: Dungeon DLCs — Sound and Silence from the Depths (50% off)
notes.content:
Some memories echo.
Some memories burn.
And some… stay etched in silence.

This week, the OST and Artbook of Dungeon of Delights open with 50% off 
— a rare moment to immerse yourself deeper into Elylah’s most enigmatic descent.

 The Original Soundtrack is composed entirely by the creator of the series. Lofi-mastered, dream-infused, and sensually restrained for private immersion. Expect ritual beats, cathedral echoes, murmurs of leather and devotion, and the breath of Vulpes behind closed doors.

 The Artbook is not a gallery — it’s a confession.
Dozens of original illustrations, concept sketches, and unfiltered erotica from the dungeon’s heart. All presented in high resolution for close contemplation or print.

This is the full descent.
Not just the game — but the sound that wrapped around it, and the vision that dared not speak during play.


And as the dungeon quiets, you may start to hear something else…

A pulse. A rhythm.
The first notes of the next composition.
The fugue is coming.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42195029/f7d80806d6f68b41980680c4d38e2b2453cfd5f3.png

notes.title: Dungeon of Delights — The Descent Was Never Meant to Be Easy
notes.content:
Not all pleasure begins with light.
Some of it begins in silence. In stone. In shadow. In submission.

Dungeon of Delights is the third chapter in the saga of Elylah and Vulpes — a descent into the sacred interior of a daemonic dream. This is the most introspective and ritualistic journey of the series so far.

You’ll encounter:


 Erotic tension blooming in confinement
 
 Hidden layers of Vulpes’ pain and memory
 
 The Sisterhood of Vesta in their full ascetic beauty
 
 And the final conquest: naming the dungeon with your own hands


  This isn’t a game about escaping.
 It’s about surrendering — and discovering who you become after.

  This week, the Dungeon opens at 50% off.

 And just beyond these chambers… something stirs.
 A new fugue forms in the dark, where seduction is no longer a trap, but a weapon.

Elylah is composing again.

 And for those who’ve longed to hold this passage in stillness, a special illustrated collection is nearing completion.

 Let the descent begin — or repeat.
 Some dungeons never forget you.
